items.source: Please note that the & and | operators may not be mixed without using parentheses. For example, "a & b | c" is not a valid expression: it must be expressed as "(a & b) | c" or "a & (b | c)".
items.translation: 请注意，& 和 | 运算符在不使用括号的情况下不能混用。例如，"a & b | c" 不是有效的表达式：必须表示为 "(a & b) | c" 或 "a & (b | c)"。

items.source: A profile expression may contain a simple profile name (for example "production") or a compound expression. A compound expression allows for more complicated profile logic to be expressed, for example "production & cloud".
items.translation: 配置文件表达式可以包含简单的配置名称（例如 `"production"`）或复合表达式。复合表达式允许表达更复杂的配置逻辑，例如 `"production & cloud"。

items.source: ! - A logical NOT of the profile name or compound expression
items.translation: ! - 配置文件名或复合表达式的逻辑非运算结果

items.source: & - A logical AND of the profile names or compound expressions
items.translation: & - 配置文件名或复合表达式的逻辑AND

items.source: | - A logical OR of the profile names or compound expressions
items.translation: | - 配置文件名或复合表达式的逻辑OR
